# Obsidian MD Opener

**笔记都在资源管理器里找到了，为什么进 Obsidian 还得再找一遍？**

捞逼产品（也就是我）想省这一步，就做了个能替我建库的打开器。第一版碰上有几千个构建文件的项目，就让 Obsidian 开始加载整个目录。我只想看一篇笔记（花了20分钟没打开，干！！）。

现在，在 Windows 资源管理器里双击 `.md` 就行。项目太大，或者光检查目录就花了 **1.2 秒**，打开器会优先用轻量仓库打开这篇笔记和能找到的附件。按下保存，改的还是原文件。

换个本机仓库也省事。刚调好的快捷键、外观和常用插件设置会自动同步，少配一遍是一遍。

[下载 Windows 打开器](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/releases/latest/download/ObsidianMdOpener.exe) · [中文使用说明](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/blob/main/readme_ch.md)

装好并启动一次 Obsidian，把下载的 EXE 放在固定位置。右键一篇 `.md`，在「打开方式」里把它设为默认应用，下次双击就好。

## English

**You already found the note in File Explorer. Why hunt for it again in Obsidian?**

My first bright idea was to make the opener turn the whole folder into a vault. Then I tried it on a project with thousands of build files. I wanted to read one note. Twenty minutes later, I’d read exactly zero notes.

Now you can double-click the `.md` file in Windows File Explorer. If the project has too many files, or the folder check alone takes **1.2 seconds**, the opener tries a lightweight vault with the note and any attachments it can find. Hit Save and your edits go into the original file.

Switch to another local vault using the opener and your hotkeys, appearance, and common plugin settings come with you. Once is plenty for setting up shortcuts.

[Download for Windows](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/releases/latest/download/ObsidianMdOpener.exe) · [English guide](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/blob/main/readme_en.md)

Install and launch Obsidian once, then keep the downloaded EXE in a permanent folder. Right-click any `.md` file, choose **Open with**, and set the opener as the default app.
